# v3 differential parser vectors. One `name<space>lowercase-hex` per line.
# Per parser: the generator seed (u64), a SHA-256 over every input
# (u32 length || bytes), the accept bitmap (bit i of byte i/8 = case i),
# and a SHA-256 over each accepted input's canonical output (u32 length ||
# bytes). The generator and outputs are described in
# proto/src/v3/golden_differential.rs.
# Regenerate only on a deliberate wire change:
# UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p eternal-wire --lib v3::golden_differential
